question: In Battle Nations, which building, at which level, is required to train the Sniper?
answer:
The Sniper is trained in the **Barracks at level 5**, and the SpecOps Center must also be built.

Source: the Sniper page on the Battle Nations Wiki (https://battlenations.fandom.com/wiki/Sniper). Its infobox lists "Barracks level 5" as the required building and "SpecOps Center" under other requirements. The local KB was synced on 2026-11-24.
